data.gender_notes: Soleman is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Soleman is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya', which means 'Sun'. In Hinduism, Surya is the deity of the Sun and is considered the source of all energy and life. The name Soleman signifies power, leadership, wisdom, and a connection to the divine. The name Soleman carries the meaning “Sun God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Soleman usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is destined to be a leader, a beacon of light and wisdom, and a source of strength and energy for those around him. The name Soleman carries the blessings of the Sun God and signifies a deep spiritual connection to the divine.
data.etymology: Soleman belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Soleman total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Soleman holds a significant cultural impact in various Hindu communities around the world. In Hindu mythology, Surya is revered as the god of the sun and is considered the sustainer of all life. Thus, the name Soleman could be seen as a connection to this divine power and symbolizes strength, generosity, and vitality. In addition, there are many rituals and traditions based on the movement of the sun, and the name could be a reminder of these cultural practices.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Soleman carries a deeper meaning connected to the Hindu concept of the universe and the divine power of the Sun. In Hinduism, the Sun is considered to represent knowledge, illumination, and the source of all energy. The name Soleman signifies the divine presence of Surya in an individual, symbolizing wisdom, intuition, and inner power. It may also represent a spiritual journey towards self-discovery, enlightenment, and understanding of the cosmic order.
